answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the delta until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ledge of the next round. Reaching the onyx of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
